|translation='''Title:''' The Force is strong with this one.

'''Card text:''' If Luke and an Imperial of ability > 2 are in the same battle, add one battle destiny (two if the opponent is Vader).

'''Lore:''' In the Death Star trench, Luke's piloting and the Force made even Darth Vader's shots on his X-wing hard to place.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese adds two destiny if the opponent is Vader; the English does so if the Imperial is Vader.
